benefits.name: Disabled Veteran Property Tax Exemption
benefits.description: Maryland provides a full exemption from real property tax on the dwelling (principal residence) of a veteran whose disability the VA has determined to be 100% service-connected, permanent, and total. The exemption can also apply where the VA finds the veteran permanently unemployable at a lower rating. The official pages reviewed did not state a home-value cap or income test.
benefits.value: Full exemption of property tax on the veteran's dwelling

otherReqs: Dwelling must be the veteran's principal residence
Veteran must own the dwelling
VA letter must state 100% service-connected permanent and total rating, or a permanently-unemployable determination

application.agency: Maryland State Department of Assessments and Taxation (SDAT)
documentation: VA disability rating letter (100% service-connected, permanent and total)
DD-214 showing honorable discharge or release under honorable circumstances

benefits.name: Charlotte Hall Veterans Home
benefits.description: Maryland's state veterans home offers assisted living, skilled nursing, and memory care to eligible Maryland veterans who are 62 or older or deemed disabled by the VA or Social Security Administration. VA per-diem subsidies reduce cost, and veterans rated 70% or greater service-connected may be entitled to the full cost of nursing home care.
benefits.value: VA per diem subsidy of $148.71/day (nursing home) or $64.19/day (assisted living) as of Oct 1, 2025; full cost coverage possible at 70%+ service-connected rating

otherReqs: Maryland veteran who served full-time active duty (other than active duty for training) and was discharged/released under honorable conditions
Age 62+ OR deemed disabled by the VA or Social Security Administration
Certain non-veteran spouses of eligible veterans may also be admitted

application.agency: Maryland Department of Veterans and Military Families
documentation: VA or SSA disability determination if under age 62

benefits.name: Edward T. and Mary A. Conroy Memorial Scholarship
benefits.description: Maryland scholarship providing tuition assistance to veterans with a service-connected disability rating of 25% or greater who have exhausted or are no longer eligible for federal VA education benefits. Limited to 15 veteran awards per year statewide; separate eligibility exists for children/stepchildren of service members who died in service or became 100% permanently disabled.
benefits.value: Maximum award of $13,689 for the 2025-2026 academic year

otherReqs: Service-connected disability of 25% or greater
Exhausted or no longer eligible for federal veterans' educational benefits
Limited to 15 scholarships/year for the veteran eligibility category
Enrolled at an eligible Maryland institution of higher education

benefits.name: Veteran's Credit for State Employment
benefits.description: Maryland state government adds a 10-point credit to passing selection-test scores for eligible veterans, spouses of veterans with a service-connected disability, and surviving spouses of deceased eligible veterans applying for state jobs; an additional 2 points apply for former prisoners of war.
benefits.value: 10 points added to selection test score (12 for former POWs)

otherReqs: Applying for a Maryland state government position using a selection test
Honorable discharge or certificate of satisfactory completion of service
DD-214 (copy) must be submitted and verified before credit is approved

application.agency: Maryland Department of Budget and Management (DBM)

benefits.legalCitation: Md. Code Ann., State Personnel and Pensions § 7-207

benefits.name: Disabled Veteran License Plate
benefits.description: The Maryland MVA issues free disabled veteran license plates to veterans rated 100% disabled or compensated at the 100% rate based on individual unemployability, permanent and total in nature. Plates are available printed with or without the universal wheelchair symbol.

otherReqs: Proof of 100% VA disability rating or 100% rate based on individual unemployability
Eligible vehicle classes: passenger cars, multi-purpose vehicles, trucks of one-ton capacity or less

application.form: Application for Maryland Parking Placard/License Plates for Individuals with a Disability (for plates with wheelchair symbol)
documentation: Proof of 100% VA disability rating or individual-unemployability determination

benefits.name: Complimentary Vehicle Registration and Initial Plates
benefits.description: Maryland veterans rated 100% disabled by the VA may receive complimentary lifetime vehicle registration; veterans rated 50% or greater may receive complimentary initial vehicle plates. This appears in the state's summary of service-connected veteran benefits; a full fee schedule was not published on the page reviewed.
benefits.value: Complimentary lifetime registration (100% rating); complimentary initial plates (50%+ rating)

otherReqs: VA disability rating documentation

benefits.name: Complimentary Lifetime Hunting & Fishing License
benefits.description: Maryland residents who are 100% service-connected disabled veterans, former POWs, or deemed unemployable by the VA can receive a complimentary lifetime hunting and fishing license covering the non-tidal angler's license, trout stamp, Chesapeake Bay sport fishing license, recreational oyster license, bow stamp, muzzleloader stamp, sika deer stamp, and furbearer permit. A related Universal Disability Pass permits qualifying individuals to hunt from a vehicle under the ADA/504 program.
benefits.value: Free lifetime hunting and fishing license package

otherReqs: Maryland resident
100% service-connected disability, former-POW status, or VA unemployability determination

documentation: Letter of disability or certification from the Veterans Administration

benefits.name: Maryland Veterans Trust Fund
benefits.description: A 501(c)(3) nonprofit core program of the Maryland Department of Veterans and Military Families that provides one-time grant awards to help veterans, surviving spouses, and Maryland National Guard members overcome financial hardship. As of the research date, the fund is temporarily pausing acceptance of new applications while it processes a backlog of requests, so current availability should be confirmed directly with the agency.
benefits.value: One-time grant award; specific dollar amount not published on the official page

otherReqs: Demonstrated financial hardship
Applications temporarily paused as of research date pending backlog processing

application.agency: Maryland Department of Veterans and Military Families (Maryland Veterans Trust Fund)
